notes: Fresh Sep 11 Toronto-morning B_V1 gate over all 168 judge candidates. Every candidate was reviewed for entity accuracy and all five B_V1 components. Common-token/ticker mismatches (including ACV fund vs ACV Auctions, ICE immigration vs Intercontinental Exchange, LG CNS vs CNS, XPeng vs XP, BYD Auto vs Boyd Gaming, Wipro CTO vs CTO Realty and other accidental mappings), evergreen/prediction content, weak/noisy evidence and duplicate angles were hard-rejected. Twelve distinct events cleared the conservative gate; fewer than 20 were retained rather than padding.
